dimensions.label: Core planning job
evidence: Precise 2D room, furniture, wall, opening, dimension, and background-plan editing
Collision, bounds, height, overlap, coverage, and walkthrough geometry tests
dimensions.gap: No decision-ready artifact connects the completed plan to a purchase or consultation decision.

dimensions.label: First-session activation
evidence: Room and furniture presets exist inside the editor
Portable project import is available from the project dialog
dimensions.gap: A new user is not guided to blank, sample, or import paths and must discover the editor unaided.

dimensions.label: Trust and data lifecycle
evidence: Local-first persistence and versioned portable files
Owner-checked cloud RPC and stale-session save guard
Explicit project and account deletion boundaries
dimensions.gap: Cloud conflict recovery and full account export remain roadmap items.

dimensions.label: Decision output and shareability
dimensions.gap: There is no self-contained human-readable report with the plan, metrics, warnings, and furniture list.

dimensions.label: Mobile usability and accessibility
evidence: Modal focus trap, inert background, Escape restoration, and 44px controls
dimensions.gap: Direct canvas entity operation is not yet screen-reader complete.

dimensions.label: Differentiation
dimensions.gap: The privacy-first advantage is not yet expressed through a distinctive decision deliverable or activation flow.

dimensions.label: Monetization and distribution readiness
dimensions.gap: There is no packaged premium-value outcome, conversion path, or validated pricing surface.

criticalBlockers.criterion: A user cannot export one human-readable artifact that supports a purchase or consultation decision.
A first-time user has no explicit blank, sample, or import choice.
